title: Sensex and Nifty give up early gains; IT shares hold up
summary: Thursday's opening gains were short-lived. IT stocks bucked the early decline as investors weighed overseas markets and US inflation.

sections.heading: A positive start fades
sections.body: Indian shares opened higher on Thursday, 26 November, but the gains did not last. By about 9:45 am IST, the Sensex was trading near 83,766 and the Nifty 50 had slipped to 25,736, according to Kotak Neo's morning report.

sections.heading: IT offers some relief
sections.body: Technology stocks fared better than the broader market. HDFC SKY's opening report noted that the IT index was higher, even as FMCG, auto and cement shares came under pressure. The morning's performance marked a change from Wednesday, when consumer stocks had led the recovery.

sections.heading: What was moving sentiment
sections.body: Markets were weighing a mixed set of overseas cues, including US inflation, Asian equities and oil prices. These were early-session developments; the final picture would only become clear after the close.
